Hi:

> str(presidential)
'data.frame':   7 obs. of  4 variables:
 $ name : chr  "Nixon" "Ford" "Carter" "Reagan" ...
 $ start: Date, format: "1969-01-20" "1974-08-09" ...
 $ end  : Date, format: "1974-08-09" "1977-01-20" ...
 $ party: chr  "Republican" "Republican" "Democratic" "Republican" ...

Observe that start is a Date object - you want the numeric equivalent, because that's what is really plotted. This works for me in version 0.9.2.1:

unemp + geom_vline(aes(xintercept = as.numeric(start)), data = presidential)

Dennis

On Thu, Nov 1, 2012 at 11:13 AM, Brad Horn <bxh...@gmail.com> wrote:
The following code appears in the book (p86) and the book website to illustrates the use of geom_vline:

unemp <- qplot(date, unemploy, data=economics, geom="line", xlab = "", ylab = "No. unemployed (1000s)")
presidential <- presidential[-(1:3), ]
yrng <- range(economics$unemploy)
xrng <- range(economics$date)
unemp + geom_vline(aes(xintercept = start), data = presidential)

In my case, I geom_vline is generating the following error:

Error: Discrete value supplied to continuous scale

Logic says I shouldn't get this error.  Any help or insight is appreciated as I want to ensure the chart annotations are feasible.

--
